text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system treats past interactions as broad interest in related products or entertainment, with insufficient attention to the specific purpose and current preference behind a choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they support a concrete activity already reflected in repeated purchases, such as storage, fastening, or small electronics work.",
    "Entertainment recommendations align when they combine specific preferences, such as a familiar artist and musical style or seasonal listening and vocal harmonies."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items receive priority despite serving different tasks, requiring unsupported equipment, or offering the wrong entertainment experience.",
    "Existing ownership is treated as demand for more similar devices or supplies, even when the need appears covered.",
    "Sparse or old interactions support stronger assumptions about current interests than the available evidence warrants."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad category, ecosystem, era, and shared-word similarity substitute for a specific connection to user purpose.",
    "Popularity and isolated historical interactions appear to support recommendations without enough evidence of personal relevance."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Repeated and recent behavior identifies narrower priorities than broad purchase or listening categories suggest.",
    "Practical choices depend on intended use, compatibility, project scale, and whether an existing purchase already satisfies the need.",
    "Entertainment choices depend on identifiable artists, subjects, tone, and sound; missing descriptive evidence leaves relevance uncertain."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Broadly plausible associations occupy top positions without establishing a concrete current use or desired experience, leaving too few compelling next choices.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, separated from items they consider merely related or potentially useful.",
    "The frequency of rejection for unsupported equipment requirements, compatibility uncertainty, already satisfied needs, or mismatched purpose and style.",
    "Whether recommendations tied to repeated recent interests rank above those supported only by broad similarity or isolated older interactions.",
    "The frequency of uncertain judgments caused by insufficient item identity or descriptive evidence, tracked separately from explicit preference mismatches."
  ]
}
